source_paraphrase: A successful build does not establish that populated installed databases survive a Room schema upgrade.
recognition_cue: An app update changes persisted Room schema or migration definitions.
decision_question: Can an installed old version upgrade without losing existing user data?
research_strategy: Compare committed schema snapshots, migration registration, historic release and installed upgrade fixture.
model_trigger: old schema -> migration step -> new schema -> retained user record
decision_proposal: Require real old-to-new migration and independent retained-data readback.
applicability_exception: Fresh install with no persisted history; no schema version change.
independent_oracle: Install old APK with populated data, upgrade same signer and independently read retained rows.

source_paraphrase: Select work scheduling primitives by lifetime and user-visible execution needs, accounting for Doze and service rules.
recognition_cue: An operation should continue while its screen is not actively visible.
decision_question: What Android execution primitive matches the required lifetime and user visibility?
research_strategy: Read current target SDK and lifecycle, WorkManager, foreground service and exact-alarm contracts.
model_trigger: user intent -> task lifetime -> platform restriction -> scheduler -> eventual outcome
decision_proposal: Use a documented supported primitive and design for interruption and resumption.
applicability_exception: Operation is only needed while UI is active and can safely cancel.
independent_oracle: Observe correct behavior after backgrounding and process interruption on supported Android APIs.

source_paraphrase: Before moving event-driven progress to WorkManager flows, inventory every event poster, subscriber and exact unique-work identity.
recognition_cue: A background worker exposes state to UI through transient global events.
decision_question: Can the UI bind to the exact worker and recover progress after subscriber recreation?
research_strategy: Trace publishers, subscribers, unique work names, tags, progress/result semantics and event replacements.
model_trigger: worker identity -> progress/result -> observer -> UI state
decision_proposal: Prefer identity-addressable state flows while preserving terminal result and existing call sites.
applicability_exception: No background worker or the event is already durably scoped and observed.
independent_oracle: Verify same worker identity across rotation and lost subscriber, and no duplicate progress publishers.

source_paraphrase: Start with the behavior claim and select the smallest test seam that can assert semantic, visual or callback behavior.
recognition_cue: A Compose UI change needs automated evidence of a user-observable behavior.
decision_question: Which existing test boundary can establish this behavior without production-only test plumbing?
research_strategy: Inspect existing test harness, semantics tree, controlled UI state and real user input model.
model_trigger: user input -> controlled state -> rendered semantics -> assertion
decision_proposal: Use the narrowest adequate existing test with controlled inputs and user-relevant assertions.
applicability_exception: Existing test already proves the requested behavior without code changes.
independent_oracle: Execute a focused test with observable semantic/visual assertion, documenting unavailable device proof.

source_paraphrase: Reusable Compose components should default to externally controlled state with a convenience wrapper when useful.
recognition_cue: A reusable UI component internally owns state that the host screen or ViewModel may need to control.
decision_question: Can an external state owner fully drive and observe the component without a private duplicate state?
research_strategy: Inspect public component API, host state owners, existing conventions and accessibility semantics.
model_trigger: state owner -> component value -> user event -> state mutation
decision_proposal: Use a controllable component contract without imposing one project's exact component naming.
applicability_exception: A deliberately private, ephemeral state has no external synchronization requirement.
independent_oracle: Drive external state and verify updates, interaction callbacks and focus semantics across recomposition.

source_paraphrase: Do not silently swallow exceptions; preserve diagnostic context while respecting user data and cancellation behavior.
recognition_cue: An operation catches failures or reports success despite an exception.
decision_question: Where does the failure become observable without exposing sensitive values or swallowing cancellation?
research_strategy: Trace exception handling, cancellation boundaries, release logging policy and user-visible errors.
model_trigger: failure -> handling -> log/UX signal -> retry or cancellation
decision_proposal: Preserve a truthful error path and minimal diagnostic identifiers without hardcoding a library's logging API.
applicability_exception: Expected benign condition has an explicit normal outcome and needs no error log.
independent_oracle: Inject a representative failure and cancellation, verify log redaction and correct user-facing state.

source_paraphrase: Audit runtime permission flows, including revoked/cached grants, denial handling and actual protected-action checks.
recognition_cue: An app uses a runtime permission or content URI grant that can change after initialization.
decision_question: Is permission or grant validity checked at invocation time and is denial recoverable?
research_strategy: Inspect manifest, target SDK, grant lifetime, current permission checks and denial/revocation tests.
model_trigger: user grant -> capability -> invocation -> revoke -> visible fallback
decision_proposal: Revalidate the exact permission boundary rather than trusting stale stored booleans.
applicability_exception: Operation uses an already-granted, lifetime-invariant local capability with no OS permission.
independent_oracle: Revoke permission before invocation and verify protected action is blocked with truthful recovery.

source_paraphrase: For untrusted received intents, constrain forwarded components, actions, data and extras through explicit allowlisting.
recognition_cue: An exported component processes external intents or forwards nested intents across app trust boundaries.
decision_question: Can untrusted intent fields redirect execution or convey authority outside the approved component contract?
research_strategy: Inspect manifest exports, received extras and destinations; verify IntentSanitizer and API/version applicability.
model_trigger: external caller -> untrusted intent -> validation -> authorized destination
decision_proposal: Allowlist or reject untrusted values at the relevant entrypoint using platform-supported mechanisms.
applicability_exception: Only fully app-internal, non-exported, trusted explicit intents with no external data.
independent_oracle: Inject a hostile nested intent and verify unauthorized destination is never invoked.
